description: 白车透视吃象，获得物质优势
explanation_en: White's rook attacks through the bishop on a6 and captures it directly, using the X-ray line to win material.

intro.popup: 💡 透视攻击：白车在a1，透视穿越黑象a6，直指a列纵深。白方如何利用这条透视线得子？
intro.popup_en: 💡 X-ray attack: White's rook is on a1, looking through Black's bishop on a6 along the a-file. How can White use the line to win material?

outro.popup: ✅ 要点：Rxa6！白车透视攻击直接吃掉黑象，白方赢得物质优势并保持主动。
outro.popup_en: ✅ Key idea: Rxa6 uses the X-ray attack to capture Black's bishop directly, winning material while keeping the initiative.

moves.popup: 白车Rxa6！透视攻击——白车沿a列透视，直接吃掉黑象，获得物质优势。
moves.popup_en: White's rook captures on a6 through the X-ray line, taking Black's bishop and winning material.
Black checks with Qc5+, trying to generate counterplay.

moves.popup: 白王逃至f1，避开将军，继续扩大优势。
moves.popup_en: The white king moves to f1 to escape check and maintain the advantage.

moves.popup: 黑兵bxc2，黑方试图利用通路兵反击。
moves.popup_en: Black's b-pawn captures on c2, seeking counterplay with the passed pawn.

moves.popup: 白车Rc6，稳住阵脚，白方凭借多得的象保持优势。
moves.popup_en: White moves the rook to c6, consolidating the position and retaining the advantage of the extra bishop.
